text:
rachel: Quick sync 1: assembling release notes and changelog for docs v0.10.0. Main items: update SDK snippets for reranking + streaming (py/ts), add embedding migration note, fix a batch of stale links in the migration guide, and a small known-issue callout about streaming choppiness with code-fenced prompts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2210 Who can own which snippet?

tom: Ill take TS snippets (reranker + streaming). I'll migrate examples to the new `await client.streamResponses()` pattern and add an async iterator example. ETA: tomorrow morning.

ben: I can do Python reranker + reconnect sample. Will include a tiny helper for incremental decode to avoid the choppy output issue. Link to my draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2215

jules: Ill sweep the migration guide links. Found a few `/embed` -> `/embeddings` redirects that currently 404. Will open a small PR for redirects and update the doc text to mention v1->v2 breaking change.

liz: For the known issue, can we be specific and include repro steps? Ops wants a reproducible snippet so QA can confirm. Also, short release-note copy should be <=140 chars.

rachel: Proposed blurb for release notes: "Updated SDK snippets for reranking & streaming. Known issue: intermittent choppy streaming with code-fenced prompts; workaround: disable streaming or trim fence lines." Thoughts?

ben: For repro: send a prompt with a triple-backtick code block that contains long lines (> 200 chars) repeated 3+ times. Streaming sometimes yields split chunks mid-line and stalls. Internal bug filed INC-6019.

jules: Thanks. I'll add a small How-To-Test section to the migration guide: 1) run the TS streaming example, 2) paste in the code-fence payload, 3) compare `stream=true` vs `stream=false`. QA checklist in PR.

tom: One question: do we include both callback-style and iterator-style TS snippets? I'd prefer iterator-only to keep docs modern, but callout for callbacks in a short note.

liz: Iterator-only is fine. Add a one-liner note that callback form is deprecated and link to the SDK changelog.

docs-bot: Preview build for PR 2210: https://deploy-preview-2210--docs.redwood.ai (status: success). CI lint: passed.

rachel: Great. Final owners: tom (ts streaming + reranker), ben (py reranker + streaming helper), jules (migration links + QA checklist). I'll draft the release-note line and push to the changelog after PR merges. Target deploy: 48hrs.

ben: One more small ask: update the examples repo link in the reranker guide to point to the new minimal app (https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/ts-rerank). I'll add that to my PR.

jules: I've got the redirects PR ready — will include a note in the changelog about the embedding endpoint rename so users know to update bookmarks.

rachel: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, drop here. I'll merge after all snippet PRs land and QA signs off. Thanks :rocket:
